newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 5c to 545c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 5c to 545c/kg.

text.p: The Australian eastern wool market indicator fell five cents to 545 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
In a weak merino fleece market, 19 micron was 3.0 percent cheaper, while 20m was 2.5 percent cheaper and 21/23/24/25/26m were up to one percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were unchanged while 29m was slightly dearer.
In cardings, lambs were 2.0 percent cheaper and locks were 1.0 percent cheaper. Crutchings were up to 1.0 percent cheaper.
WI said most interest came from Japan and Western Europe with support from most other sectors.
Of 20,710 bales offered 14.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle, with about 36,500 bales to be offered.
